title: Annual General Meeting 2019 - Invited Talk

descriptionHtml: An invited talk on interview facing skills by Dr. Maheshi Dissanayake (Senior Lecturer, Faculty of Engineering, University of Peradeniya and the Advisor of IEEE WIE SB AG of University of Peradeniya) was held on 23rd October 2019 at the Faculty of Engineering, University of Peradeniya along with the Annual General Meeting of the IEEE WIE Student Branch Affinity Group of University of Peradeniya.
